query:
UPDATE employees
            SET updated_at = $2,
                contact_phone = $3,
                contact_email = $4,
                contact_telegram = $5,
                user_id = COALESCE($6, user_id),
                is_owner = COALESCE($7, is_owner),
                is_manager = COALESCE($8, is_manager),
                is_master = COALESCE($9, is_master),
                manager_branch_id = $10
            WHERE id = $1
